perspective:
Gloria Bangura has access to the following information:

- She has worked alongside Donald Ortega as a colleague at the event planning company, where he works as a bartender during events.
- Over several company events, she directly observed Donald’s distracted demeanor and lack of enthusiasm while serving drinks.
- She approached him about it and asked if everything was okay with his job.
- He told her: “I guess I’m just not as into it as I used to be. It’s kind of repetitive.”
- After that conversation, she began to suspect his work dissatisfaction might point to deeper personal issues.
- She suggested he consider talking to a professional about it.
- He told her: “I haven’t really considered that, Gloria. I’m not sure if that would help.”
- After that conversation, she sensed a shift in Donald’s behavior toward her and worried he might resent her suggestion, feeling she had overstepped.
- She apologized to him, explaining she meant well and did not want to make assumptions about his life.
- He told her: “It’s okay, Gloria. I was a bit taken aback at first, but I know you meant well. It’s just a lot to process.”
- She felt relieved that the tension had eased.
- She invited Donald to collaborate on an upcoming project because she wanted to strengthen their professional relationship.
- He accepted, saying he appreciated the offer and wanted to be more involved.
- During the project, she directly observed Donald’s significant contributions and renewed enthusiasm.
- She publicly acknowledged his work in a team meeting, saying his efforts were crucial to the project’s success.
- He thanked her and said the recognition meant a lot to him and that it felt good to be appreciated.
